myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: Kd and affinity, spare receptors, inverse agonists and constitutive activity, quantal dose-response curves.

myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: glucokinase regulatory protein (GKRP).

myLectures.name: TCA Cycle and Pentose Phosphate Pathway
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: citrate synthase regulation details.

myLectures.name: Bioenergetics
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: redox potentials, the Q cycle as a superoxide source, antimycin A (complex III), mitochondrial genome details (13 proteins, 22 tRNAs, heteroplasmy).

myLectures.name: Gluconeogenesis and Glycogen Metabolism
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: glycogenin, GSD 0, Andersen (IV), Hers (VI), and von Gierke Ib (G6P translocase, neutropenia).

myLectures.name: Fructose, Galactose, Sorbitol and Ethanol Metabolism
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: fructose bypassing PFK-1 and feeding liver fat via citrate, formaldehyde/glycolic acid intermediates, ADH affinity as the basis of ethanol therapy.

myLectures.name: DNA Repair and Recombination
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: O6-methylguanine, E. coli Mut proteins and GATC methylation, site-specific recombination, benzo[a]pyrene, HIV integration.

myLectures.name: Heme Metabolism
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: glucose's effect on ALA synthase, variegate porphyria, congenital erythropoietic porphyria, erythropoietic protoporphyria, and the OATP and MRP2/MRP3 transporters.

myLectures.name: Cytogenetics
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: ISCN nomenclature, CMA resolution and SNP allele tracks, segregation patterns of reciprocal translocations, paracentric vs pericentric inversions, optical genome mapping. The slides only name the trisomy syndromes, so their clinical-feature cards were left out.

myLectures.name: Cell Cycle
myLectures.note: Cards picked to match the slides. Slides only: N and C counts through mitosis and meiosis, the specific cyclin-CDK pairs (D-4/6, E-2, A-1/2, B-1), p21 and p16, cohesin breakdown with maternal age. Homologous recombination vs NHEJ was picked for Thursday's DNA Repair lecture, so it isn't repeated.
